Delivering an accurate, timely and secure payroll service to New Zealand schools.

Education Payroll is responsible for paying around 102,000 teachers and support staff in around 2,500 schools every fortnight. That’s approximately $294 million each pay period and $7.7 billion each year.

The complexity of the schools’ payroll system is constantly evolving, and we work to make things as easy as possible for our customers. EdPay ‒ our online portal for schools to submit payroll instructions ‒ is designed with and for schools.

We also provide phone advice and guidance to school administrators and principals, assess teachers’ qualifications and experience to set their correct salaries, administer third-party payments and manage overpayments.

It’s the combination of people, processes and cutting-edge technology that enables us to do this well. Our agile approach enables us to be flexible and adaptable, and respond to changes in education sector payroll requirements.
